candidates: When writing a comment that explains why an error is suppressed or treated as non-fatal, name the exact error type (e.g. `AbortError`) rather than using vague language like 'any errors' with a parenthetical example. Precision here helps future maintainers know whether new error types should also be covered.

When documenting a workaround in a code comment, include the specific runtime conditions or environment (e.g. a particular framework, build tool, or configuration such as React.StrictMode) under which the problem occurs, so future maintainers can reason about the scope and continued necessity of the workaround.
